articles.title: Russia's largest bank plans crypto wallet launch as Moscow clears market path
articles.snippet: Services will integrate into "Sberbank Online" and "SberInvestments" once the "On Digital Currency and Digital Rights" bill takes effect in September.

articles.title: Bitcoin's Sharpe Ratio slides to lowest since 2022. Here's what it means.
articles.snippet: A reading that negative means investors would have been better off in risk-free assets like 10-year U.S. Treasuries.

articles.title: Coinbase AI draws backlash after erroneously publishing World Cup result before kickoff
articles.snippet: CEO Brian Armstrong investigated, and the firm said it made updates to prevent future AI-generated inaccuracies.

articles.title: Collateral, not yield, will decide which stablecoins win
articles.snippet: As yield-bearing stablecoins race toward a $50 billion market capitalization, the industry is optimizing for the wrong metric, argues Artem Tolkachev, chief RWA officer at Falcon Finance.

articles.title: Bitcoin price falls up to 4% on Strategy BTC sale as trader sees Summer 2022 repeat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin wiped out much of its latest gains thanks to a market reaction to Strategy's 3,600 BTC sell-off, but analysis eyed a potential buy announcement in the coming days.
